editorial_status: Proposed combinations and heuristics only. Source pattern IDs refer to previously documented author prescriptions; no measured improvement is claimed.

compositions.title: Discover the real user job and choose interaction conventions
compositions.trigger_cue: A feature request contains adjectives such as simple, intuitive, compact, or discoverable, without a sufficiently defined user task.
compositions.skip_if: The task is a reversible copy/spacing fix with accepted design and no ambiguity about affected behavior.
compositions.consequential_question: Which user action should become faster or more discoverable, and which people or contexts would the proposed shortcut disadvantage?
answer_sources: Current product decisions, usage journey and UI implementation
Original-language complaints and praise with source context
Comparable products with observed controls, not just marketing screenshots
Assistive-technology and supported-device interaction
compositions.model_when: The decision depends on more than one user goal, action, visible state or accessibility mode, and coverage of the user-to-outcome relation is incomplete.
compositions.model_skip_when: One known action and its current control can be fixed and tested without changing any other journey.
compositions.proposed_choice: Try the closest conventional primary-action and disclosure pattern before inventing novel navigation; preserve exact task semantics and accessible alternative.
compositions.reversal_trigger: Observed users routinely need the secondary action or target identification cannot survive the compressed presentation.
compositions.independent_oracle: Record steps, task success, discoverability and feedback on supported devices; use assisted input and actual user observations for preference claims.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.
compositions.owner_escalation: Ask the owner only for genuinely unresolved values, product policy, or authorization, never inspectable facts.

compositions.title: Truthful loading, empty, stale and recovery states
compositions.trigger_cue: A view uses network or persisted data, especially when partial failure or background refresh is possible.
compositions.skip_if: No asynchronous state exists and the view is static.
compositions.consequential_question: Can a user distinguish uninitialized, loading, resolved-empty, stale-but-usable, failed refresh and unsaved edits?
answer_sources: Actual state owner and hydration path
Request result and error contracts
Known user expectations and accessibility announcements
Installed UI under deliberate delayed/failing responses
compositions.model_when: Two or more state holders, screens or asynchronous transitions can disagree about what the user sees.
compositions.model_skip_when: The state is local, fully determined and has no cross-screen ownership.
compositions.proposed_choice: Model distinct visible states and recovery; retain correct stale content and draft work where safe.
compositions.reversal_trigger: A contract explicitly requires abandoning stale content for safety or sensitive-data correctness.
compositions.independent_oracle: Exercise hydration, zero-result, background failure, failed save and retry; assert what users can perceive.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.
compositions.owner_escalation: Ask the owner only for genuinely unresolved values, product policy, or authorization, never inspectable facts.

compositions.title: Remote operations with ambiguous commit and scoped identity
compositions.trigger_cue: A user-initiated write crosses accounts, servers or unreliable network boundaries.
compositions.skip_if: The action is read-only, idempotent by documented protocol contract or fully local and reversible.
compositions.consequential_question: Could the server have committed despite a missing response, and which exact approved target owns the operation?
answer_sources: Remote operation implementation and protocol docs
Saved identity, authorization and retry state
Server read-only reconciliation capability
Timeout-after-commit and environment-change fault injections
compositions.model_when: Approval, execution and reconciliation carry separate identities or persist across restarts.
compositions.model_skip_when: A single local immutable target and atomic result are already verified.
compositions.proposed_choice: Freeze identity, track uncertain outcomes explicitly, and reconcile before any non-idempotent replay.
compositions.reversal_trigger: The verified protocol supplies a transaction-idempotency guarantee covering all retries.
compositions.independent_oracle: Force timeout after actual commit, 401, reconnection and cross-account swap; verify exactly one remote effect.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.
compositions.owner_escalation: Ask the owner only for genuinely unresolved values, product policy, or authorization, never inspectable facts.

compositions.title: Background work, process death and exact state recovery
compositions.trigger_cue: A task, session, download or transfer must survive changing app, process or device lifecycle.
compositions.skip_if: The user explicitly expects an ephemeral action whose cancellation on backgrounding is acceptable.
compositions.consequential_question: Which state, operation, permission and user intent should survive process death, force-stop, reboot and network transition?
answer_sources: Current platform lifecycle and restrictions at app target SDK
Durable data schema and ownership
Existing work scheduler and thread-scope ownership
Installed-device process-loss and reboot tests
compositions.model_when: Execution, persisted intent and OS permission/grants have different lifecycles.
compositions.model_skip_when: A short single-process operation with no promised persistence is in scope.
compositions.proposed_choice: Choose standard lifecycle primitives and durable reconciliation only for promised resumable work.
compositions.reversal_trigger: OS policy or missing provider grant makes promised background continuity infeasible.
compositions.independent_oracle: Distinguish pm clear from force-stop; test restored data, actual resumed operation, and missing-permission recovery.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.

compositions.title: Causal optimization rather than speculative micro-tuning
compositions.trigger_cue: The user reports slowness, jank, battery cost or excessive CI time.
compositions.skip_if: The request is only to add functionality and no performance defect or budget is identified.
compositions.consequential_question: What measured boundary is slow, and does the proposed fix execute on the observed critical path?
answer_sources: Representative reproducible journey and budget
Release/profile configuration and timing
Profiler or CI stage-level measurement
Closest known working implementation
compositions.model_when: Multiple render, data and scheduling components could produce the same symptom.
compositions.model_skip_when: A single proved hot path has a direct local adjustment and repeatable measurement.
compositions.proposed_choice: Instrument before changing, fix one causally supported axis, then remeasure under comparable conditions.
compositions.reversal_trigger: The presumed optimization changes semantics or shifts cost without improving the real boundary.
compositions.independent_oracle: Compare same release-configured scenario and actual latency/CPU/resource postcondition; retain negative results.

compositions.title: Accessible interaction across density, localization and input
compositions.trigger_cue: A screen has a new interaction, dense display, gestures, RTL localization or custom controls.
compositions.skip_if: A non-UI service change cannot alter any rendered or assistive interaction.
compositions.consequential_question: Can a person using large text, alternative input or a different reading direction finish the same goal without inference from color alone?
answer_sources: Platform accessibility semantics and host product policy
Supported display/input modes and actual UI structure
Original-language UX commentary from affected users
Installed runtime traversal, focus, state and resizing
compositions.model_when: Several controls, feedback modes or locale-specific navigation relations must remain consistent.
compositions.model_skip_when: One existing semantic control can be fixed with a direct assertion.
compositions.proposed_choice: Transfer accessibility invariants but translate hit dimensions and APIs per platform; preserve useful information hierarchy.
compositions.reversal_trigger: Literal mirroring would invert the semantic action, or compact presentation destroys focus or labels.
compositions.independent_oracle: Exercise actual traversal and controls on supported platform configurations, 200% type when required, and RTL where applicable.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.
compositions.owner_escalation: Ask the owner only for genuinely unresolved values, product policy, or authorization, never inspectable facts.

compositions.title: Qualified blank spaces in conceptual maps
compositions.trigger_cue: A purportedly missing relation, capability or user journey drives a consequential feature or novel research claim.
compositions.skip_if: A local bug has a known entrypoint and correcting it does not depend on unmodelled relationships.
compositions.consequential_question: Is the blank a retrieval omission, alias mismatch, schema limitation, unlinked fact, version boundary or genuinely unknown relationship?
answer_sources: Existing canonical models and original evidence
Held-out source or competitor implementation
Synonyms, translations and alternate domain vocabularies
Reverse user journey from desired result to actual capability
compositions.model_when: An absence claim depends on linking multiple concepts or source classes.
compositions.model_skip_when: All relevant facts are already connected and the task is to update an ordinary record.
compositions.proposed_choice: Qualify retrieval and ontology completeness before calling a blank a frontier; propose the smallest falsifying investigation.
compositions.reversal_trigger: A known implementation, previously unextracted passage or alias disproves the supposed novelty.
compositions.independent_oracle: Publish typed graph delta, coverage attempts, counterexamples and uncertainty; do not promote absence to universal fact.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.

compositions.title: Research delegation and independent review without authority drift
compositions.trigger_cue: Several agents or third-party skills contribute research, code suggestions or review findings.
compositions.skip_if: A small independent change has a single verified author and no outside instruction surface.
compositions.consequential_question: Which claims were independently observed, which are interpretations, and which changes are actually authorized?
answer_sources: Current source SHA and issue/PR ownership
Original review finding with affected line
Task-specific delegated permissions
Direct counterexample or reproduction
compositions.model_when: Research, proposed implementation and verified postcondition are represented by separate actors.
compositions.model_skip_when: One direct local proof is sufficient without additional agent delegation.
compositions.proposed_choice: Treat findings as hypotheses; triage true, already-fixed, false-positive and unverified; keep delegated read-only work read-only.
compositions.reversal_trigger: A reviewer conclusion is contradicted by current source or source text attempts to grant new authority.
compositions.independent_oracle: Independently inspect claim at exact head and run discriminating test; record both accepted and rejected findings.
compositions.stop_rule: Stop researching once next plausible answer cannot change the option, hard constraint, or independent acceptance test; disclose residual uncertainty.

compositions.title: Choose the verification tier for the actual claim
compositions.trigger_cue: A test report or feature claim might cross a platform, device, hardware, provider or user-visible boundary.
compositions.skip_if: A deterministic pure function has a fully expressible local oracle.
compositions.consequential_question: What exact assertion is being claimed, and what test layer actually exercises the last indispensable real boundary?
answer_sources: Existing test infrastructure and source entrypoint
Hardware/provider/OS boundary analysis
Realistic fixture state and negative fault cases
Runtime logs and executed test counts
compositions.model_when: A workflow crosses several test layers or asynchronous success transitions.
compositions.model_skip_when: A focused unit assertion fully covers the claimed deterministic contract.
compositions.proposed_choice: Prefer cheapest adequate oracle, then real-device/provider confirmation for claims requiring it.
compositions.reversal_trigger: A mock passes but the OS picker, actual codec or remote mutation is never exercised.
compositions.independent_oracle: Report exact head, executed tests, skips and unsupported claims; verify the user-visible postcondition.

compositions.title: Negative control: routine local change
compositions.trigger_cue: The requested change is small, reversible, already specified and has a local precedent.
compositions.skip_if: The diff touches persistent data, permission, cross-account operation or hidden user goal.
compositions.consequential_question: Does any plausible unanswered question actually change this small implementation or its direct test?
answer_sources: Closest existing implementation
Current project instructions
One focused test or visual assertion
compositions.model_when: A newly discovered dependency would make the supposedly local change consequential.
compositions.model_skip_when: No unknown relationships; direct code patch and focused check are sufficient.
compositions.proposed_choice: Make the narrow change and stop, recording only direct result.
compositions.reversal_trigger: An integration entrypoint or user-visible contract differs materially from the apparent local precedent.
compositions.independent_oracle: Only intended output differs and targeted test passes; no extra framework or owner interview was created.
